page-structure.evidence: Title is descriptive (passes 2.4.2). Heading hierarchy has multiple issues: (1) First DOM heading is H3 'Elite Career Bootcamp. Top Job Offer Guaranteed.' (duplicated) before the page H1 'Accelerate Your Elite Career' — structural inversion; (2) H1 is followed immediately by H6 '...with intense bootcamps + self-study courses' (level skip H1→H6, axe heading-order); (3) H2 'When Everything Changes' followed by H5 '500,000+ Topics & 3 Million+ Comments' (H2→H5 skip); (4) Multiple H4s under H2s while H3s appear elsewhere breaking consistent hierarchy. No h1 as true page title in proper position (axe best-practice). Two <nav> landmarks with no aria-label to differentiate them. Page has hasMain:true, hasNav:true. Three multiple unlabelled <nav> landmarks.

grouping-and-reading-order.evidence: 21 lists with list-style:none detected; without explicit role='list' these risk losing list semantics in VoiceOver/Safari (WebKit-specific 1.3.1 concern). role='menu' on .popular-forums__menu has children with no role='menuitem' (plain DIVs) — required children missing, confirmed by axe aria-required-children (critical). Reading order: tabWalk shows skip link first (off-screen), then header nav, then forum tabs — consistent with DOM/visual order in viewport.

reflow.evidence: At 320px viewport: scrollWidth=640, clientWidth=320, ratio=2.0. scrollWidth 640 vs clientWidth 320 at 320px viewport (ratio 2.0). General layout elements (navbar, hero banner, forum nav) overflow — not exempt.
Play Video button (isInteractive:true) not in any of 50 global Tab stops; localTabWalk reachedByTab:false (positioned:false); box.x:-99514 — rendered far off-screen and keyboard-unreachable.
